NBA DFS Picks for Thursday, November 19 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, November 19 · 4 games · First game 8:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 19, 11:31 AM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Thursday, November 19 DraftKings main slate at 57.4 DraftKings points for $12,000. Karl-Anthony Towns (NYK, 46.7, $9,600) and Deni Avdija (POR, 45.1, $9,200) are next.

Donovan Clingan (POR) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.61 projected points per $1,000 at $6,900.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 19, 11:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
